label: a background transition counts as a foreground return (R-rn-reconnect)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/native/reconnect.test.ts -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R7: a return to the foreground is the only transition that resumes"

label: resume reopens the stream at zero and replays what the reader already read (R-rn-reconnect)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/native/reconnect.test.ts -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R7: a foreground return reopens the stream from the last applied seq and appends only the new event"

label: the offline banner drops its one manual retry (R-rn-reconnect)
test: cd mobile-rn && npx jest src/native/reconnect.test.ts -t "KIN-MOBILE-001 R7: the offline banner offers one retry that reopens the stream"

label: the screen subscribes to app-state changes but never resumes on a return (R-rn-reconnect)

label: a resume after close reopens the stream and paints the closed screen (R-rn-reconnect)
